name: power-view
description: Power View: the Progress Only style with a live steps box and hidden tool calls, plus the Tools tray for model, effort, styles and helper agents, an Agent CLI pane to chat with other agent CLIs, a files pane with an editor, and a Sessions pane to start, switch and resume sessions, and an Agent team pane that shows the agents Claude starts, what each is doing, and a box to message each
